The original SKILL.md and full MIT LICENSE are retained beside this notice.
The application does not execute upstream scripts or install an agent plugin.
Backend integration: lib/recipe-intelligence/refinement.ts.

Only conservative guidance about filler, run-ups, clarity and preserving voice
is adapted. The upstream suggestions to add specifics or reactions, restructure
paragraphs, change headings/formatting, remove claims or do full rewrites are NOT
adopted. The application's strict preservation rules take precedence. The model
selects bounded, precomputed copy edits; it cannot supply arbitrary article text.
This feature is editorial refinement and makes no AI-detector claim.
